normalized_facts.advisory: Soil map unit(s): Ur (Urban land, 0 to 6 percent slopes). Flags: prime-farmland classification — Farmland Protection Policy Act review applies to any federally-funded or permitted project. SSURGO is broad-acre mapping; site-specific geotech, OSSF evaluation, or wetland delineation is required for any binding decision.

manual_upload_request.reason: SSURGO is broad-acre soil mapping. A site-specific geotech investigation is required for any foundation or grading design. For parcels considering OSSF, an on-site sewage facility evaluation is required by the county OSSF office. Hydric components trigger a wetland delineation.
